description: This C# source file defines the class ModuleProjectLiquidFileProvider, which implements IFileProvider to serve liquid template files from project assets during development in OrchardCore.

classes.name: ModuleProjectLiquidFileProvider
classes.description: A custom implementation of IFileProvider that provides access to module liquid files during development.

methods.name: ModuleProjectLiquidFileProvider
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the provider with application context and maps module assets to project assets.

methods.name: GetDirectoryContents
methods.description: Returns directory contents; currently always returns not found.

methods.name: GetFileInfo
methods.description: Returns file info for a given subpath, mapping module asset paths to physical files if available.

methods.name: Watch
methods.description: Watches a file for changes, returning a change token if the file is tracked.

methods.name: NormalizePath
methods.description: Converts backslashes to forward slashes and trims slashes for path normalization.
